feature_name: Third-party smart chips and link previews
summary: Third-party smart chips and link previews let Google Workspace Add-ons preview links with smart chips.
extended_definition: Third-party smart chips and link previews let Google Workspace Add-ons preview links with smart chips.

supporting_pages.title: Google Apps Script release notes \_|\_ Google for Developers
evidence_snippets: To learn more, refer to the following: Google Workspace Updates blog : View & compare script versions with Apps Script project history Developer documentation : Versions June 12, 2023 Feature Third-party smart chips and link previews are now generally available.
To build a Google Workspace Add-on that uses this feature, see Preview links with smart chips .
January 24, 2024 Feature ( Generally Available ): Google Workspace Add-ons now support third-party resource creation from the @ menu in Google Docs.
